name: dlw-staff
description: Simple task-runner monorepo for dlw-staff (standalone backend & frontend)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: node -e "const{spawn}=require('child_process');const p=[spawn('npm run dev:backend',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}),spawn('npm run dev:frontend',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})];const stop=()=>{for(const c of p){if(c.pid&&!c.killed){process.platform==='win32'?spawn('taskkill /pid '+c.pid+' /t /f',{stdio:'ignore',shell:true}):c.kill('SIGTERM')}}};process.on('SIGINT',stop);process.on('SIGTERM',stop);for(const c of p){c.on('exit',code=>{stop();process.exit(code??0)})}"
scripts.migrate:path: node -e "const{spawnSync}=require('child_process');const a=process.argv.slice(1);if(!a[0]){console.error('Contoh: npm run migrate:path -- 2026_01_01_000000_example.php');process.exit(1)}const p=a[0].startsWith('database/')?a[0]:'database/migrations/'+a[0];const r=spawnSync('php artisan migrate --path='+p+' '+a.slice(1).join(' '),{cwd:'back-end/staff.app',stdio:'inherit',shell:true});process.exit(r.status??1)"
